αὐθαίμων: of the same blood, a brother, sister, kinsman
βαρυδαίμων: pressed by a heavy fate, luckless
εὐσχήμων: elegant in figure, mien and bearing, graceful
κακοδαίμων: possessed by an evil genius, ill-fated, ill-starred, miserable
πέπων: cooked by the sun, ripe, mellow
παράφρων: wandering from reason, out of one’s wits, deranged
ἀστυγείτων: near or bordering on a city
ὀνειρόφρων: versed in dreams and their interpretations
